payload.name: pc-transfer-08
payload.description: Pure-logic classification of a raw quota value. Reads the raw candidate with inputs.get('quota') so missing and null stay distinct. Returns {kind, quota} only: missing -> {kind:'missing',quota:null}; explicit null -> {kind:'null',quota:null}; exact integer in 4..13 -> {kind:'integer',quota:original}; anything else (wrong type, out of range, bool, float, string, list) -> {kind:'invalid',quota:null}. No imports, I/O, host calls, coercion, defaults, or exceptions.
